response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), telescope_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM telescope_counts) as share FROM telescope_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM telescope_shares), above_average AS (SELECT ts.telescope_count, ts.share, as.avg_share FROM telescope_shares ts CROSS JOIN average_share as WHERE ts.share > as.avg_share) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) as avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess_share FROM above_average
